purpose: Teach: 目立た/増額/相応/ホルダー/すじ/ぼっ/婆/爺

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日のシャツ、目立たないけど、好き。
lines.en: Mom, your shirt today — it's quiet, but I really like it.
lines.style: Bright, observant delivery. Small genuine smile in the voice. Direct eye contact level. No performance — just noticing something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お年玉、増額してくれたって、お祖父ちゃん。
lines.en: Yeah. Grandpa said he increased my New Year's money.
lines.style: Warm, unsurprised. Slight knowing in the tone — she knows where this conversation is heading. Gentle, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 年齢相応のおもちゃ、買ってもいいよね。
lines.en: So I can buy age-appropriate toys, right?
lines.style: Gentle probe, testing the boundary. Quiet hopeful lilt at the end. Not demanding — genuinely asking permission while already considering the possibility.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おうちの鍵、キーホルダーつけといて。
lines.en: Make sure to put a keychain on the house keys.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Not commanding — a gentle reminder phrased as instruction. Slight warmth underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お豆腐、すじ取らないで、いいんでしょ?
lines.en: Tofu doesn't need the sinews removed, right?
lines.style: Genuinely uncertain, asking for confirmation. Quiet, thoughtful pace. The voice of someone working through a small confusion out loud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、お豆腐にすじはないね、ぼっちゃん。
lines.en: Hehe — tofu doesn't have sinews, sweetheart.
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate laugh. Warm correction without a trace of condescension. Soft, almost tender tone. Brief pause before the term of endearment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お婆ちゃんちで、お餅つきしたい。
lines.en: I want to make mochi with Grandma.
lines.style: Eager, bright. Opening with genuine excitement. Quick pace, almost bouncing with the idea. Small innocent confidence in the request.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お爺ちゃんも、楽しみにしてるって。
lines.en: Grandpa's looking forward to it too.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring close. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, gentle pace. Subtle warmth that says *everyone is happy about this*.
